Translation speed

Run searches on the translator to record trials. Each measurement starts when the search request is sent and ends when the result is displayed.

The first use of an AI model may include model download and index setup. Results therefore depend on the selected model, device, browser, input, cache, and network. Separate first-use and repeat trials when reporting results.

Translation trial log

The latest 500 translation trials are saved in this browser. Successful, failed, and no-match searches remain in the log. Export the data before clearing it.
